placements.title: instrument calibration as an organizational practice
placements.frame: What calibration work establishes and verifies instrument readiness across the observatory?

placements.title: calibration established and verified against reference standards
placements.frame: How does the observatory assert and verify instrument calibration as a settled state?
placements.why: src-1 declares the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibrated at a precise frequency; src-2 reports collective verification against named June reference plates and claims validity across the full observing band; src-4 restates the same calibration-and-verification facts as structured metadata. Together they support the theme of calibration as an asserted-and-verified settled state — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as new calibration events and reference checks accumulate.
